1007 [02:02] <holycow> a: you will only be able to read the ntfs files
1008 [02:03] <holycow> b) you wont be able to write to an ntfs partition
1009 [02:03] <stig_> I only need to read from it :)
1010 [02:03] <holycow> ms keeps ntfs info secret, and any interim support for write has essentially dissapeared as no one cares enough to maintain the components
1016 [02:03] <holycow> 1. you need to find your ntfs partition with sudo fdisk -l
1018 [02:04] <holycow> 2. you need to create a folder in say /media to wher eyou will mount to the ntfs partition ... mine is /media/ntfs
1019 [02:04] <holycow> 3. you need to add info about the partition to your /etc/fstab
